THE COMPANY

Rooted in Oklahoma City.
Built for what comes next.

Austin Meridian is an independently operated brand based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, bringing apps, games, and future ideas together.

FitQuest is the first project: an exercise-based fantasy adventure currently in development and testing. Future apps and games will have their own identity here, with Austin Meridian bringing the work together.

OUR APPROACH

How the work
takes shape.

A personal approach to building and improving each project.

01

Purpose first.

Begin with a useful idea and a clear audience. FitQuest explores a more motivating way to build an exercise routine.

02

Build, test, and refine before release. Be clear about what is available, what is still being tested, and where to get help.

03
